decision.reason: [ev-49061bdffc5b] is a single changelog line saying the background cache size limit check is now done "atomically" and "correctly", with only a pointer to PR 11654. It doesn't name the config key or limit involved, what the check did before versus now, which setups use the background cache, or what happens to an operator who does nothing. The PR or the code diff would be needed to fill in the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
